blurb: Guests enjoy private wine tastings featuring flights of current release wines, personalized guided service, and a private table on the tasting lawn with vineyard views. The winery is family-run and located in a historic red barn and Victorian home setting. Visitors can bring picnics but no outside drinks are allowed.
